automations.pane.lede: Saved prompts, and the triggers that launch them for you.
automations.recipe.title: New recipe
automations.form.how.webhook: POST JSON (or a form) to it. {{body.ref}} in the prompt is that field of the body; {{text}} is all of it.
automations.form.how.slack: Through the Slack app connected in Settings → Channels: a message to it from one of the people below starts it.
automations.form.how.linear: In Linear: Settings → API → Webhooks → New webhook, this URL, data change events for Issues.
automations.form.secretPlaceholder.webho: Sent as x-wisp-secret, or signs each call
automations.form.secretPlaceholder.linea: Shown when you create the webhook
automations.form.missing.name: Give it a name.
automations.form.missing.prompt: Say what it asks, or pick a recipe to run.
automations.form.missing.label: Say which label starts it.
automations.form.missing.secret: Give it a secret: a call must know it, or sign with it.
automations.form.missing.people: Name the people who may start it (their Slack member IDs).
automations.form.missing.connector: Pick the MCP server it listens to.
automations.form.missing.event: Pick which of its events starts it.
